message: No detected input validation: The code only drops NaN rows and filters out '-' similarity values; there are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming CSV data.

No detected untrusted source handling: CSV files are read directly from local paths and the BERT tokenizer is loaded from HuggingFace Hub without any checksum verification, pinned commit/revision, or authentication.

No detected label flipping detection: The code prints label value counts and filters out '-' labels, but does not validate label distributions against expected baselines, compare train/val/test label distributions for anomalies, or use any label-noise detection tool like Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code only drops NaN rows and filters out '-' similarity values; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious/poisoned input samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads 'bert-base-uncased' via transformers.BertTokenizer.from_pretrained without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision parameter.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no implementation of any backdoor or trigger detection mechanism such as neural cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard TensorFlow/Keras training with no differential privacy libraries (e.g., TensorFlow Privacy, Opacus) or DP-SGD mechanisms applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a separate test set is loaded, there is no signing/hashing of evaluation data, no isolation enforcement, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code only drops NaN values during training data preparation; there is no input validation, shape/range checks, or schema validation on inference-time inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is present that checks model output probabilities for NaN values, out-of-range values, or applies calibrated thresholds before returning predictions.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although BERT is used for text processing, there are no prompt-injection defenses, input filtering, system-prompt isolation, or output content moderation implemented anywhere in the visible code.
